( a ) make firm, fasten (compare ) whence אֶדֶן ; ( b ) determine, command, rule , whence אָדוֺן ; ( 3 ) Thes Add., MV and others ( a ) intransitive be under, low, inferior (compare דּוּן , ), whence אֶדֶן ; ( b ) transitive put under command, rule over (compare דִּין ) whence אָדוֺן ; see also (4) Lag M. i. 102 , אָדוֺן from ).
